snippet.title: hi, i made some frogs for your desktop
snippet.description:
sign up to Milanote for free with no time limit: https://milanote.com/shar !!

🐸 download frog pond here (it is free and full of my heart): https://sharyap.itch.io/frog-pond
🐸 frog pond holiday 2024 merch collection: https://shop.sharyap.com/collections/frog-pond-holidays-2024

--

hello what's up!! 😎✌ making videos is a bit hard huh HAHA but i think i'm getting the hang of it a little! editing isn't my strongest skill so i'm getting a lot of practice out of these. also i bet you're shocked there are two of these videos in one month (i am also shocked) but i hope you get to bring these little frogs i made into the holiday season!!

i'll update the frog pond game a bit more over the next month or two, and if people really like it i think it would be fun to put stuff for special occasions (valentines, summer, etc.) it's nice programming practice on my end also! it's also just pretty fun to update it in general hehe

the next video is gonna be an animation! and then i'll be working on a few lightly-animated gaming videos hehe i hope you stick around for those :) hope you guys have a great holiday season!!! jingling bells and what not

--

🐱 visit my yard in neko atsume 2??
